content:
Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Brand Identity & Positioning
RLVNT is a contemporary streetwear and apparel label built around bold visual culture, iconic sports and pop-culture references, and everyday oversized silhouettes. Every seasonal drop—including the signature Winter Collection—pairs expressive graphic storytelling with heavyweight comfort. Core brand pillars include Cultural Relevance, Unapologetic Visual Impact, Everyday Quality, and Transparent Service.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Product Architecture
RLVNT product architecture encompasses three primary categories: 1) Graphic Crewnecks & Hoodies: Heavyweight relaxed-fit tops crafted for cold-weather layering, including 100% cotton hoodies and high-contrast statement crewnecks. 2) Sports & Vintage-Inspired Tops: Football jerseys, half-zip pullovers, and retro-styled track jackets designed for casual street styling. 3) Bottoms & Full-Outfit Sets: Washed wide-leg denim, relaxed sweatpants, and coordinated monochrome sets.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Visual Guidelines & Color Palette
The RLVNT wordmark is our primary brand identifier featuring custom crimson bubble typography framed by an oval ring and anchored by a centered five-point star. Official Color Palette: RLVNT Crimson (#8F1D1D), Streetwear Black (#111111), Poster Off-White (#F8F6F4), Crisp White (#FFFFFF). Proportions maintain clear space equal to the star height.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Ordering & Verification Policy
All orders placed through the website or official social channels are subject to stock availability. Customers receive an automated confirmation with order number, itemized garments, sizes, and total amount. For high-value or cash-on-delivery orders, RLVNT may verify by phone or WhatsApp prior to dispatch.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Pricing & Order Modifications
Product prices are displayed in local currency (EGP). Accepted payment methods include Cash on Delivery, Debit/Credit Cards, and Mobile Wallets. Order Modifications & Cancellations: Customers may request a size change, address correction, or full cancellation within 12 hours of placing an order, provided the parcel has not yet been handed to the courier. Once dispatched, changes must follow the Returns & Exchanges Policy.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Shipping & Delivery Policy
Order Processing Time: Orders are verified, packed in protective packaging, and dispatched within 1-2 business days (excluding public holidays). Delivery takes standard delivery timeframe depending on destination governorate. A tracking update is sent via SMS/WhatsApp once dispatched. Couriers attempt delivery 2-3 times. Inspection Upon Delivery: Customers must inspect the outer parcel upon arrival. If damaged in transit, report within 24-48 hours with clear photos of the packaging and garment.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Returns & Exchanges Eligibility
Eligibility Requirements: Return or exchange requests must be submitted within 14 days from the date of delivery. Item Condition: Garments must be unworn, unwashed, free of perfume, stains, or pet hair, and returned in original RLVNT packaging with all tags attached. A valid order number or receipt is required for every request.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Resolution & Shipping Cost Matrix
1) Size or Style Exchange: Swap for another available size or equal-value item (or store credit if sold out). Return shipping is covered by the customer. 2) Defective or Wrong Item: Priority replacement with the correct item or full refund upon photo verification, with 100% of return shipping covered by RLVNT. 3) Standard Return / Refund: Refund issued to original payment method or store credit after warehouse inspection. Original and return shipping fees are non-refundable. 4) Non-Returnable Items: Final-sale clearance items, washed/altered garments, or items missing original tags.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Inspection & Refund Processing
Returned parcels undergo quality inspection within 2-3 business days of arriving at our warehouse. Approved refunds are processed within 5-7 business days via original payment method or wallet store credit.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Sizing & Fit Guidelines
RLVNT pieces—including 100% cotton hoodies, heavyweight graphic crewnecks, vintage-cut jerseys, and wide-leg bottoms—are designed with relaxed streetwear proportions. Because oversized fits differ from standard slim sizing, customers should review the published size chart before completing checkout.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Garment Care Standards
Recommended Garment Care for Print & Fabric Longevity: 1) Washing: Turn graphic crewnecks, hoodies, and jerseys inside-out. Machine wash cold (30°C max) on gentle cycle with similar colors. 2) Detergent: Use mild liquid detergent only. Never use chlorine bleach, harsh stain removers, or fabric softeners on prints. 3) Drying: Hang dry or lay flat in the shade. Avoid high-heat tumble drying to prevent cotton shrinkage and print cracking. 4) Ironing: Steam lightly or iron inside-out on low heat. Never press a hot iron directly onto printed artwork or embroidered badges. Damage resulting from improper washing, high-heat drying, bleaching, or direct ironing is not covered as a manufacturing defect.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Brand Governance | Section: Customer Support & Official Contact
Our support team is committed to resolving sizing inquiries, order updates, and exchange requests promptly. Support operating hours: Saturday through Thursday, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM. Target response time: within 24 hours. Official contact channels include WhatsApp, Instagram Direct Message, and Email. Support handles high-value verification, size swaps, transit damage reports, and customer escalations.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Winter Collection Lookbook | Section: Winter Drop Overview
The RLVNT Winter Collection showcases 9 signature statement crewnecks crafted from heavyweight cotton with high-contrast graphic storytelling. Featured designs include: San Andreas ('Ah Shit, Here We Go Again' CJ graphic), Michael Jackson Tribute (gold sparkle glove & moon), Kylian Mbappé 2022 World Cup celebration, Diego Maradona Argentine D.N.I., 'DOGS GOTTA EAT' crimson varsity lettering, Jude Bellingham 'Bellingoal' Real Madrid celebration, Fight Club Tyler Durden with soap bar, RLVNT 'Dream Big' thermal star graphic, and Tony Montana 'Scarface' American Dream montage. All tops feature relaxed streetwear fits.

Brand: RLVNT | Doc: Outfits Collection Lookbook | Section: Outfits & Bottoms Overview
The RLVNT Outfits and Sets collection features coordinated streetwear combinations: 1) 100% Cotton Hoodies: Heavyweight Lionel Messi black signature gold hoodie and Neymar Jr chocolate brown gothic Total 90 hoodie. 2) Retro Sports Tops: 1990s AC Milan Opel sponsor Lotto long-sleeve kit and Germany 1990 heritage DFB track jacket. 3) Coordinated Sets: Cristiano Ronaldo CR7 Manchester United crewneck with black sweatpants, Polo Ralph Lauren half-zip fleece set, Real Madrid Los Blancos crewneck with heather grey sweatpants, and 'NO FEAR' gothic lion crewneck set. 4) Bottoms: Vintage washed wide-leg denim jeans and cotton fleece relaxed sweatpants.
